description: This file defines a data holder class for pocket account mappings within the Apache Fineract project, specifically for self-service pockets feature. It includes collections for different account types and a factory method to instantiate the class.

classes.name: PocketAccountMappingData
classes.description: An immutable data transfer object encapsulating collections of pocket account mappings for loans, savings, and shares.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new immutable instance of PocketAccountMappingData with specified account collections.
